content: For therapeutic use and any potential adverse effects on a breastfed child due to the drug or the underlying maternal condition, the following applies: 1. The therapy is generally considered acceptable. Controlled studies conducted in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk. 2. When preparing the solution, slowly inject 4 mL of the reconstituted solution into a 250 mL IV bag containing 0.9% NaCl. Gently invert the IV bag to mix the solution thoroughly. Do not shake the IV bag, as this may cause foaming. 3. Administer the infusion over a period of one hour. Do not administer the solution as an IV push or bolus. 4. This medication is not intended for intra-arterial, intramuscular (IM), intrathecal (IT), intraperitoneal, or subcutaneous (SC) administration. 5. For storage, the unreconstituted vial should be kept at controlled room temperature, specifically between 20-25°C (68-77°F). Temporary excursions are permitted within the range of 15-30°C (59-86°F). 6. Once reconstituted or diluted in an IV bag, the solution should not be stored for more than 24 hours, whether at room temperature or refrigerated (2-8°C or 36-46°F). 7.
